messages:
zara (releases): quick note 1: nightly canary showed model-binding mismatches after runtime 2.16.2 rollout. thinking a short-lived pin of the runtime on a small cohort while runtime team debugs. suggestions? :ear:

otto (runtime): saw the mismatch logs. some model->kernel binding lookup falls back and increases CPU sched latency. pin runtime for cohort 'canary-small' for 2h.

li (sdk): is this visible to SDK users? should we add a warning in responses if we route to pinned runtime?

maria (mlops): models unaffected functionally but perf varies for heavy multi-turn. model owners ok with pinned cohort if it buys time.

sre-jon: proposal: soft-pin runtime 2.16.1 for canary-small in us-west-2, reserve +20% capacity, monitor 95/99 latency and cpu steal. abort if 99p > 2x baseline.

zara (releases): change window: 02:00-06:00 UTC. schedule pin at 02:10, monitor 30m. If stable promote gradually.

otto (runtime): plan: reproduce with binding tracer, ship tiny kernel micropatch if repro is quick. Otherwise keep pin and rollforward to 2.16.3 with kernel-fix.

li (sdk): I'll silence SDK autopromote and freeze release notes. adding a header flag for routed responses: `X-Runtime-Pinned: true` on fallbacks.

sre-jon: runbook snippet:
```
# soft pin runtime for canary cohort
deploybot pin runtime 2.16.1 --region us-west-2 --cohort canary-small --duration 2h --drain-delay 90s
# rollback: deploybot unpin runtime 2.16.1 --reason "auto-abort"
```

maria (mlops): I'll run stress multi-turn tests at 02:05 UTC and post heap/cpu traces.

zara (releases): approvals: @otto, @li, @sre-jon. please respond :ok_hand: if approved.

otto (runtime): :ok_hand:

li (sdk): :ok_hand: noted on header and release notes freeze.

sre-jon: :ok_hand: alerts and capacity buffer in place.

zara (releases): deploybot scheduled the action. will reconvene at 02:45 UTC with telemetry. thanks everyone. :rocket:
